about: Bistromat is an intimate open-kitchen restaurant in the heart of Vračar, close to the Temple of Saint Sava and far from the city noise. Combining French culinary technique, cooking the Escoffier way, with carefully sourced local ingredients, we create refined dishes of European gastronomy in a warm, homely setting where the food is prepared right in front of you, for unforgettable flavours and an experience people talk about.
aboutShort: An intimate open-kitchen restaurant in the heart of Vračar, by the Temple of Saint Sava. French technique the Escoffier way, with carefully sourced local ingredients.
landmark: Vračar, by the Temple of Saint Sava

directions.title: Parking
directions.text: The nearest public garage is Baba Višnjina (Baba Višnjina 38), open 24/7: 100 RSD per started hour from 7am to 10pm and 50 RSD at night. Street parking is in a paid zone. A new 356-space garage is being built under the square in front of the Temple and the National Library.

directions.title: Public transport
directions.text: The nearest stops are by the Temple of Saint Sava on Bulevar oslobođenja, and at Slavija. From either, we are a 5 to 10 minute walk.

directions.title: Entrance
directions.text: The entrance is directly from Mutapova Street, under the black Bistromat sign. The entrance is wheelchair accessible. If you need help getting in, call us and we will meet you at the door.
